Label: Strike / Decapitation (US-Israel)
Description: Initial and ongoing military strikes against Iranian leadership, military, and nuclear-linked infrastructure.

Label: Retaliation (Iran and Proxies)
Description: Missile, drone, and proxy attacks across the region carried out in response to strikes.

Label: Political Capital Sunk
Description: Accumulated political and reputational cost on all sides that makes stopping harder than continuing.

Label: Hormuz Closure (Iran)
Description: Iran's closure of the Strait of Hormuz, used as a coercive lever against oil-dependent economies.

Label: Global Oil and Shipping Shock
Description: Disruption to global energy markets and shipping routes caused by the closure.

Label: Economic Pain (All Sides)
Description: Rising economic cost felt domestically by all belligerents and by the global economy.

Label: Pressure to De-escalate
Description: Diplomatic and domestic pressure building toward a negotiated settlement.

Label: US Appetite for More Strikes Falls
Description: Declining willingness and material capacity within the US command structure to continue strikes, per internal assessments.

Label: Political Override of Military Assessment
Description: Political leadership publicly rejects or overrides the military's internal de-escalation assessment, sustaining escalatory rhetoric and action despite exhaustion signals. Added 20 Aug 2026 based on the documented Caine-Trump gap.
